Liquidated Damages. In the event of sellers failure to deliver stores within delivery period, an amount of 0.5% per week (or part thereof) in delay of s

tores delivery shall be levied as LD on seller. Waiving off of LD, shall be sole discr etion of buyer, if the buyer is convinced that reasons for delay in delivery of store s were not attributable to/beyond control of seller. Max LD levied shall not be gre ater than 10% of value of delayed stores. 26. Termination of Contract. Buyer shall have right to terminate the contra ct in fwg cases. (a) Delivery of store is delayed for a period greater than 21 days and delay is not attributable to force majeure clause. Performance guarantee s hall be forfeited. (b) Seller is declared bankrupt. (c) Delivery of stores delayed due to common attributable to force maje ure clause beyond 42 days. Performance guarantee shall be returned. (d) Seller submits that he shall not be able to supply any stores. Perform ance guarantee shall be forfeited. 27. Notices. Any notice required/Permitted under supply order shall be w ritten in English & delivered by dak/ by hand/ on email, No whatsapp message, p hone call etc shall serve the purpose or shall be taken cognizance of. 28. Transfer / Subletting. Seller has not right to give, sublet etc partly/w holly the supply order to any other posn/firm / third party etc. PART-IV SPECIAL CONDITIONS OF RFP 29. Option Clause. Buyer can exercise an option to procure an additional 50% of the original contracted qty in accordance with same terms conditions as given sch of requirement of RFP and at the same price quoted for each items by successful bidders. It will be solely the discretion of buyer to exercise this clause or not. While awarding the supply order, this clause can be utilised. 30. Repeat Order Clause. Buyer can order upto 50% under present sch o f requirement given in RFP within 6 months from date of successful completion of this contract, cost terms & Conditions remaining same. It will entirely discretion of Buyer to place repeat supply order or not. The total increase the qty of all SO (

original/Repeat) from the qty given in RFP shall not be more than 50% RFP qty. 31. Tolerance Clause. Buyer reserves the right to increase/decrease the qty of required goods by 50% without any change in terms/condition/prices quoted b y seller. While awarding of the supply order this clause can be utilised. 32. Price Negotiation with L1 Bidder. The buyer can enter with price negotiation with and only with L1 bidder to achieve lower quotes in case the lowe st rate quoted is not falling within the financial sanction available with buyer. In s uch case ,the L1 bidder can agree to decrease his price to enable buyers to place supply order. Results of price negotiation shall be uploaded on GeM. These can b e no change in terms/conditions of original RFP in exchange of covering cost by L 1 bidder. 33. Generating Invoice and CRAC and GeM. Post Receipt of stores ins pection by Consignee and intimation of inspection report to supplier, the supplier may generate invoice in GeM. The consignee shall generated acceptance certific ate (CRAC) on GeM for the received qty no payment shall be due to seller till the time complete qty of items is recd by buyer. Part CRAC shall not be liable for part payment. 34. Payment. Payment can only be made post generation of part of whole CRAC on GeM. Part payment can be made to supplier based on assessed value of stores delivered by supplier. Part payment for part delivery for only those items o f BoQ shall be made, whose number in BoQ is more than one. In assessing the va lue of stores delivered both the market rate and the rate derived from lumpsum r ate quoted by supplier (Contractor profit factor shall be calculated as ratio of quo ted rate and TS rate. Assessed cost of delivered items as per rate quoted shall be deemed as market rate x profit factor). The payment shall be made based on the lesser of the two cost thus ascertained. Part Payment if made, shall only be 85% of the ascertained/market cost of items delivered. In case of composite items like structure of shelter, no part payment shall be made. An amount of 10% can be h eld up even after generation of CRAC for clearance of final payment post signing of BKI/IC from user unit. 36. Payment for Part Stores In Case of SO Cancellation. In case th e seller is not able to supply complete store, and the supply order cancelled, pay ment for part stores certified/CRAC generated shall be made in accordance of ris k and expense clause. 37. Risk Expense Clause. (a) Should the seller be unable to supply complete store within the deliv ery period,even after extension of 21 days has been given, the buyer shall be at full liberty to cancel the supply order.

(b) If at time of cancellation of supply order, part stores have been deliv ered by supplier, he shall be liable for being paid for store supplied as per a vailing market rates or as per quoted rates, whichever is less, minus the su rplus amount required to procure the balance item of supply order from an other source (Surplus amount being calculated as fresh purchase amount minus purchase amount based in rates of cancelled supply order). To ascer tain the market rates, the buyer may ascertain rates by mean of a Board of Officers or ascertain rates or by floating tender for supply of balance items. Performance guarantee shall be forfeited in this case after 01 year of SO da te. (c) Recoveries made on account of surplus amount required to procure part/whole of stores of cancelled supply order shall not exceed 25% of SO a mount. . 38. Force Majeure. Should any force majeure circumstance arise, buyer/ sell er shall be excused for non-fulfilment of contractual obligation, if the affected par ty, within 5 days of its occurrence, inform other party in writing. Force Majeure shall mean floods, natural disasters for other acts, that are unanticipated or unfor eseeable, and not brought about at the instance of the party claiming to be affect ed by such event, or which, if anticipated or foreseeable, could not be avoided or provided for, and which has caused the non performance or delay in performanc e, such as war, turmoil, strikes, sabotage, explosions, quarantine, restriction bey ond the control of either party. A party claiming Force Majeure shall exercise reas onable diligence to seek overcome the Force Majeure event and to mitigate the e ffects thereof on the performance or its obligations under this Supply Order. 39. Specification. The seller shall guarantee to meet specification as pe r Part-II of RFP. Revision in specification shall be acceptable only on upload side o n buyer confirmation only. 40. Warranty. The seller shall provide 12 months warranty on all supplied under supply order. The seller shall provide the entire necessary OEM warranty c ertificate along with stores and shall be liable for all repairs and replacement duri ng the warranty period. Failure of seller to repair/replace stores within warranty period within 14 days of intimation of defect shall render buyer at liberty to liquid ate performance guarantee for defect rectification.
